sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: open weights, 5.6B parameters
sources.snippet: Today we are releasing FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B parameter open weights model for text-to-image generation, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images. It shares core capabilities with the full FLUX 3 Image model: native 4K generation, pixel-perfect editing, and bounding boxes that control where elements are placed or confine edits to a defined area.

sources.title: GitHub - black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein: FLUX 3 Image Klein ...
sources.snippet: Model page • Weights • Demo This repository contains the reference inference code for FLUX 3 Image Klein, the 5.6B open weights image model from Black Forest Labs: text-to-image, editing with up to 10 reference images, and layout control with bounding boxes, through one model. It ships with a prompt upsampler; do not use the model without it.
